knowledgePlugin.name: a11y-knowledge-odsp
knowledgePlugin.description: Compatibility installation for existing ODSP knowledge users. New users install a11y-knowledge, which includes this read-only submodule and all references.

topics.trigger: Looking for any original AgentOW accessibility knowledge, source provenance, coverage or an omitted reference.
topics.scope: Current complete snapshot routing and explicit exclusions; the six v0.2 bodies below are legacy compatibility references.

topics.trigger: Implementing or reviewing SPDS or Fluent V8/V9 component semantics, composition, announcements, focus, theme or component selection.
topics.scope: Complete component and design-system source references, applied only to the actual library/version/project.

topics.trigger: SharePoint/ODSP announcements, page/canvas focus, component import paths, theme, drag/drop, content checks or review rules.
topics.scope: Project-specific static knowledge; no resource, workflow or execution prerequisite.

topics.trigger: Classifying user impact, selecting criteria or distinguishing real AT from supporting diagnostics.
topics.scope: Shared criteria and evidence reasoning; not workflow authorization.

topics.trigger: Implementing or reviewing rendered UI, names, roles, states, announcements, focus, keyboard, contrast or reflow.
topics.scope: General review principles with an explicit odsp-web / SPDS / Fluent implementation profile.

topics.trigger: Producing or validating AgentOW version-1 reproduce/verify request and result artifacts.
topics.scope: AgentOW bridge-v1 integration profile, not the A11y Assist provider RPC or its delivery policy.

topics.trigger: Preparing authorized Windows AT capture, audio, console rendering or scenario-specific host readiness.
topics.scope: Windows evidence producer procedures; referenced setup commands are supplied by AgentOW, not this knowledge package.

topics.trigger: Selecting, capturing, reviewing or publishing screenshots, recordings, annotations, headings or Voice Access evidence.
topics.scope: Evidence quality rules with an ADO publication profile.

topics.trigger: Using the approved persistent Chromium profile for authenticated BEFORE/AFTER screenshots.
topics.scope: AgentOW browser integration profile; scripts and host authorization remain external.
